articles.title: Weak monsoon, West Asia risks cloud July-Sept FMCG demand
articles.description: Consumer goods demand faces challenges from a weak monsoon and rising inflation. FMCG volumes saw a slight slowdown in the recent quarter, signaling potential future impacts. The full effect of delayed rainfall on rural spending is expected this quarter.

The company has an extensive distribution network reaching numerous retail outlets and hospitals. Kedaara will partner with Tynor's promoters and its existing strategic partner Thuasne.
